compute_TernaryLoss: compute the ternary loss between an original image and a warped image for optical flow evaluation
compute_SSIM: compute the structural similarity index between two image tensors as a distance metric
compute_smooth_grad_1st: compute first-order gradient-based flow smoothness loss weighted by image or segmentation edges
compute_smooth_grad_2nd: compute second-order gradient-based flow smoothness loss weighted by image or segmentation edges
compute_smooth_homography: compute homography-based flow smoothness loss by estimating per-segment homographies with RANSAC
